payload.posture: Read Jeremiah 52:12–23 as evidence about the Temple, keeping its action, claim, context, and limits distinct.
payload.tension: The passage states a second destruction account dates Nebuzaradan’s arrival and narrates the burning, wall demolition, exile, and dismantled bronze. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the Temple.
